name: Hotel Fairmont Le Manoir Richelieu
positioning: French-chateau-style hotel between mountains, forest and the St. Lawrence River in Charlevoix, with golf and a spa (official name: Fairmont Le Manoir Richelieu)
best_for: Golfers and couples who want a river-view base in Charlevoix
Families who want year-round activities in summer and winter

facts.text: The hotel sits between mountains, forest and the St. Lawrence River in Charlevoix.
Guests have access to the Multi-Sports Centre, with indoor and outdoor pools, steam rooms and an exercise room.
Dining includes gourmet meals at Le Saint-Laurent and family-friendly options at Le Bellerive.
Family activities run year-round, from hiking and mini-golf in summer to ice skating and snowshoeing in winter.
Winter activities include snowshoeing, ice skating, ice fishing and winter via ferrata.
A casino is located right next door to the hotel.
Check-in is from 4:00 pm and check-out is by 11:00 am.

highlights.text: The hotel was built in the late 19th century in French-chateau style.
The golf course has 27 holes, carved into rolling hills with views of the St. Lawrence River.
Moment Spa sits on the banks of the St. Lawrence River and offers massages, facials and body treatments.
The Deluxe View Jacuzzi King room has a king bed, a St. Lawrence River view and a large Jacuzzi.

considerations.text: The hotel is about 90 minutes from Quebec City.
Le Point Cardinal serves its scenic brunch by the golf course in season only.
WhataHotel notes the remote location means longer travel time from major cities.
